targetTexts.1: Hallelujah! Praise the name of the LORD. Give praise, O servants of the LORD,
targetTexts.2: who stand in the house of the LORD, in the courts of the house of our God.
targetTexts.3: Hallelujah, for the LORD is good; sing praises to His name, for it is lovely.
targetTexts.4: For the LORD has chosen Jacob as His own, Israel as His treasured possession.
targetTexts.5: For I know that the LORD is great; our Lord is above all gods.
targetTexts.6: The LORD does all that pleases Him in the heavens and on the earth, in the seas and in all their depths.
targetTexts.7: He causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth. He generates the lightning with the rain and brings forth the wind from His storehouses.
targetTexts.8: He struck down the firstborn of Egypt, of both man and beast.
targetTexts.9: He sent signs and wonders into your midst, O Egypt, against Pharaoh and all his servants.
targetTexts.10: He struck down many nations and slaughtered mighty kings:
targetTexts.11: Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and all the kings of Canaan.
targetTexts.12: He gave their land as an inheritance, as a heritage to His people Israel.
targetTexts.13: Your name, O LORD, endures forever, Your renown, O LORD, through all generations.
targetTexts.14: For the LORD will vindicate His people and will have compassion on His servants.
targetTexts.15: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, made by the hands of men.
targetTexts.16: They have mouths, but cannot speak; they have eyes, but cannot see;
targetTexts.17: they have ears, but cannot hear; nor is there breath in their mouths.
targetTexts.18: Those who make them become like them, as do all who trust in them.
targetTexts.19: O house of Israel, bless the LORD; O house of Aaron, bless the LORD;
targetTexts.20: O house of Levi, bless the LORD; you who fear the LORD, bless the LORD!
targetTexts.21: Blessed be the LORD from Zion—He who dwells in Jerusalem. Hallelujah!
